title: CLAUDE.md chatId spec is stale (sha256 vs ULID)
description: CLAUDE.md line 149 says chatIds are hex(sha256(sorted_user_ids)) and the defensive input table says 'recompute from participants and compare'. Both are wrong. Code (chat.rs:279) and kith-architecture.md:686 agree: chatIds are server-assigned ULIDs. A contributor reading CLAUDE.md will implement unnecessary sha256 recomputation in Peer/deliver and file a bug report when it rejects all inbound messages. — Update CLAUDE.md line 149 and the Peer/deliver defensive input row to reflect the actual ULID design and the correct validation (contact_id check, not chatId recompute).
